title: Grateful Dead Live at Berkeley Community Theater on 1971-08-14
source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > C > DAT; Transfer Info: DAT > Sony D8 > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Transferred, tracked and mastered by Bill Guarneri, August 5, 2014

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar Berkeley 8/14/71 show highlighted by a smoking Other One.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this August 14, 1971 Berkeley performance, calling the entire concert great and singling out a spectacular Other One. The sweet‑sounding soundboard tape is praised for its clarity, making the high‑energy setlist easy to enjoy.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4–5 stars and highlighted both a superb musical performance (especially the Other One) and an excellent‑sounding recording, resulting in a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as "sweet" and clear; no dropouts or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set called "stellar Dead," overall flow smooth with high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: One reviewer hopes Phil isn’t turned down too much in the mix, indicating awareness of bass levels.
